BackstoryDef.title: hive larva
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} hatched deep in the hive tunnels and spent {PAWN_possessive} early days scuttling between egg sacs, drinking in the dark and the pheromone-song of the swarm.

BackstoryDef.title: swarm daughter
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} grew into a daughter of the swarm, digging and hunting and guarding the queen's burrow, and dreaming of the man she would one day drag back to it.

BackstoryDef.title: hollow-floor grub
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} hatched in the damp dark under a house floor, one of a colony that had moved in beneath the boards, and spent {PAWN_possessive} early days eating whatever the workers brought back.

BackstoryDef.title: scuttling devil bug
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} grew up quick on {PAWN_possessive} feet, scouting the dark edges of the hive by smell and dragging back under the floor whatever the colony asked for.

BackstoryDef.title: tunnel child
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} hatched in a nest deep underground and spent {PAWN_possessive} early days hauling spoil along the tunnels and following the scent trails of the workers.

BackstoryDef.title: tireless giant ant
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} worked the nest from dawn to dark, cutting tunnels through solid rock and carrying loads far heavier than herself, and came home each night to the man the nest had taken for her.

BackstoryDef.title: shell grub
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} hatched with {PAWN_possessive} shell already hard, and spent {PAWN_possessive} early days in the leaf litter drinking sap while the armour thickened.

BackstoryDef.title: lancer soldier beetle
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} grew into a lancer of her kind, silent in the ranks, quick to duel for the place she wanted, and slow to leave the man she picked.

BackstoryDef.title: munching greenworm
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} hatched as a soft green grub among the hive's egg sacs, and spent {PAWN_possessive} early days eating, sleeping and eating again, storing up everything {PAWN_possessive} body would need later.

BackstoryDef.title: still-hungry greenworm
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} never spun a chrysalis and never grew wings, staying soft and slow and hungry all day, eating whatever the hive's stores can spare.

BackstoryDef.title: nectar-fed wriggler
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} hatched in the standing water at the bottom of the hive, and spent {PAWN_possessive} early days drinking nectar, learning to hold still in the air, and watching the workers come and go.

BackstoryDef.title: prowling vamp mosquito
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} grew into the hive's huntress, circling a man for hours before she strikes and leaving a mark that brings him back to her long after he has gone.

BackstoryDef.title: sealed swarm princess
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} slept sealed deep underground for ages, one of the daughters kept for the day the swarm would be wanted again.

BackstoryDef.title: swarm-mother abaddon
BackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} woke under an open sky and the swarm woke with her, flying where her scent told it to fly and taking the men she chose.
